text:
taylor: Heads-up — multiple customers escalating after this morning's canary. 5xx (primarily 502/504) spike aligned with canary cut at ~02:15Z. Short sample from logs:
```json
{"error":"gateway_timeout","status":504,"route":"/v1/generate","request_id":"req_abc123"}
```
Customers: billing requests timing out + user-facing API errors. Example curl we've been sent:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
lee: Looking at infra graphs — canary hosts show 504 rate ~12% vs prod ~0.4%. P95 latency on canary nodes doubled. Spike begins exactly when canary weight moved to 10%.
maria: Which config diff landed in the canary? I see `header_normalizer=v2` and `kvcache_prefetch_window=0` in the canary manifest.
nashish: (typo) ashish: The `header_normalizer=v2` change includes stricter header trimming. Might be dropping `X-Client-Auth` which some customers use for routing/authz upstream.
taylor: Support reports customers see missing auth header causing upstream to reject -> gateway timeouts. Also billing webhooks failed for two tenants.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy canary-452 started 2026-03-17T02:15Z weight=10% image=service:v3.4.1
lee: Recommend pausing rollout and rolling canary back to 0. Can someone run rollback now?
nashish: Running rollback commands: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference inference=service:v3.4.0 && kubectl patch rollout canary/canary-452 --patch '{"spec":{"weight":0}}'`
ops-bot: rollback initiated by ashish at 02:22Z — progress: 0/3 clusters -> 2/3 clusters -> 3/3 clusters.
maria: For engineering repro: steps to reproduce locally:
1) Use a forwarded customer token and call `/v1/generate` with and without `X-Client-Auth` header.
2) Send a long streaming prompt to exercise KV cache path.
Example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Client-Auth: foo" -d '{"prompt":"test"}' https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
lee: After rollback completes, watch 5xx rate and p95 for 30m. Capture traces for any remaining 5xx: pull traces with `trace-id` header from customer requests.
support-bot: Notifying affected customers now (ETA ~30m). Linking tickets: C-1234, C-1235, C-1241.
nashish: Rollback complete — canary weight -> 0 at 02:26Z. First metrics showing drop in 504s on canary fleet.
taylor: Good. Keep monitoring. If 504 > 1% in next 15m escalate to P1. Also please start a short postmortem draft (owner: maria) and include exact config diff + timeline. :thumbsup:
lee: I'll collect traces and metrics dashboard links and drop them in the PM.
maria: Will start the postmortem and ping infra for a config gate to prevent header_normalizer flips without integration tests.
support-bot: Customers updated. Will reopen tickets if they report anything new.
nashish: Quick note — rolling back image also reverted a tiny kernel selector change; need to separate causes in the PM.
taylor: Thanks all. Closing thread after 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:
